text_block_list.text:
The morning of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—
I was walking through the empty racecourse with Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I come here, it always reminds me.
About the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaa...!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Armed with the fighting spirit of absolutely refusing to lose,
I poured everything into the race that day."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And—
I take great pride in running such a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much.
...And today—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To a Tiara route race held in that same Kyoto,
which ought to bring about an excitement even greater than back then—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: She isn't here.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I will be running in the Japan Cup.

—That press conference took place
just yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see...! Aiming for consecutive victories, you're taking on your second Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I hear that lately, compared to her prime,
she hasn't been in the best form.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is the pinnacle of domestic racing. Although Orfevre-san, who is one of the very strongest, won't be competing this time—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Another stellar lineup should be gathering this year.
...Of course, you know that winning once doesn't make winning again any easier, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: "Still, the fans will undoubtedly expect back-to-back victories! Do you feel confident!?"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna-san!
Frankly speaking, what is your current condition—
And regarding your past defeats—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —The defeated should hold their tongues.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"As I am right now,
I have no words to speak."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
let us prove it through victory.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have...
absolute power.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...To be cornered like that and still remain so dignified. Truly, how like her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If it were me... how would I fare?
I wonder if I could carry myself like that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Can she continue to wear that
absolute trust in herself, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh,
do you really think so?
choice_data_list: They probably already believe in you.
They probably already believe in you.

text_block_list.text: Ever since her victory at the Victoria Mile, her radiant beauty had only grown. It stemmed from the noble confidence of a true queen――
choice_data_list: With today's victory, you will become the flawless, perfect queen.
With today's victory, you will become the flawless, perfect queen.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And...
let us return to Tokyo.

—Post time drew near,
and the stands were brimming with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
My top pick is Verxina!
She's this year's Mile Queen, after all—
she'll definitely crush it at medium distance too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That's true. The girls she defeated the other day are here today as well, after all...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm predicting another girl will take the lead!
I mean, did you see the paddock!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone had such incredible drive!
Today's race is going to be so exciting~!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I couldn't catch you in May, but... I've gotten stronger since then. I'll be taking the queen's throne this time around!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—I will dethrone that queen!
—The next star in the spotlight will be me...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—H-Hey, Vivlos...!
...I'm fine right here, really.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Let's watch from closer up!
I gotta cheer for Big Sis♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look, Big Sis is coming out!
Big Siiis—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Big Sis today was
just... just...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this is...
a bit too sparkly—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
please unleash your fighting spirit just as it is.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because I refuse to lose,
I can become even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If this is a race where the one with the proudest strength belongs at the pinnacle...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“There can only be one winner.
—And it can't be anyone other than me, Verxina!”
